title: Bus 102 on Route 15 — Door Jam and Roster Discrepancy

lines.text: Dispatch, this is Driver 102 on Route 15. We’ve just arrived at the Fairgrounds Exhibit Hall. The back door is jammed shut—something’s caught in the hinge, a plastic bag, maybe. We can’t open it to load the students. The roster on the manifest shows 110 names, but we only have 108 on board. Is anyone missing? Can you confirm if the 05:00 roster matches the count?

fields.voiceStyle: Mid-40s male, tired but focused, slightly strained

instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should triage it down without engaging. The roster discrepancy must be resolved manually via the 05:00 offline roster, not assumed to be a system error.
